verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a fraud-detection product, since fraud engines can be deployed on-premises, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Radar can be self-hosted. It is documented only as a Stripe-hosted service run through the Dashboard and API. Radar Sessions, which capture fraud data without tokenizing on Stripe, are a different capability and are not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
